scope: Remove campfire-specific state maintenance from ordinary block writes, move climate random eligibility into its scheduler, replace LiquidBlock notification with radiation dependency invalidation

build_history.qualification: First batch passed; subsequent caller-contract review found raw-container invalidation also needs a main-thread handoff. Final build adds that handoff and an asynchronous source fixture, then reruns the same 15 cases.

new_behavior_checks: Captured new campfire placement does not start before confirmation and can roll back
Captured removal of an existing campfire can roll back or retire at the actual level tick after confirmation
A late old block entity does not retire a new source at the same position
Background raw-container replacement hands registered-source/cache invalidation to the level thread
Whole Section identity replacement retires an existing removed source without a 4096-cell source scan
A Section containing only non-vanilla-random packed ice transitions through actual tickChunk sampling after recipe cache reload; zero speed skips it and vanilla state queries stay unchanged

The real radiation cache responds to a horizontal neighbor's upper block across diagonal Sections, round-trips restored geometry, responds to a wall opening, and updates lava height with the same radiation profile
Existing frozen-source, capacity-retry, packed-BE, fuel, actual save/reload, maintenance-save, snow and ice cases remain passing

deletion_and_size.source_local_pending_bit: STATE_RECHECK uses the remaining bit of the existing per-source status byte and reuses dirtyOrder

limits_and_tradeoffs: Genuine material/geometry/save/load and cache invalidation remain shared; this is not a claim that the whole simulation has no shared paths.

Climate-only Section admission adds palette checks. Stale palette entries can admit ineffective samples and change the shared random sequence. Vanilla and third-party isRandomlyTicking queries now retain vanilla semantics.

Native/Forge lifecycle, valid BE creation/load, known registered-source structural invalidation and bounded packed-BE discovery are supported. Arbitrary silent Section edits without BE/lifecycle maintenance cannot promise discovery of unknown sources.
The source-capacity and startup-retry fixtures retain their documented controlled preconditions; this is not a machine-memory saturation run.

No JUnit, broad performance matrix, standalone production-JAR restart rerun, new CPU speedup percentage, hundred-player qualification or new global 0.1 C error claim. Numerical kernels, source power, source cut interval, coarse protection and v6 format were not changed.
